simpleDesign.note: Could not run the full Playwright/Cucumber suites locally — this worktree has no installed dependencies (node_modules absent at repo root and app level), and a monorepo-wide install was out of scope for this stage. Per the spec's own Test Approach, QA runs scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh and test:bdd against a running app; both existing suites already exercise these page objects (checkout.steps.ts calls cartPage.completeTransaction(), the home/inventory scenarios exercise clickFirstProductDetails's destination) with zero .feature/assertion changes made here.
complete-transaction-btn names the button by its action, replacing both the guessed has-text selector and the misleadingly-named checkout-btn testid.
Reused the existing item-name testid already rendered by ItemCard.vue instead of adding a third, redundant testid to the same anchor.
Deleted the now-stale two-line comment explaining the has-text guess; no new elements, classes, or abstractions introduced.

keyDecisions.decision: Renamed CartView.vue's existing checkout-btn testid to complete-transaction-btn in place rather than adding a second attribute.
keyDecisions.reasoning: Grep confirmed checkout-btn has exactly one occurrence repo-wide, so the rename is isolated and leaves no stale attribute that could silently reattract a future locator.

keyDecisions.decision: Pointed HomePage.ts's clickFirstProductDetails() at the existing item-name testid instead of adding a new testid to the item-card anchor.
keyDecisions.reasoning: ItemCard.vue already renders data-testid="item-name" on a router-link to the same /item/${item.id} destination the old nested selector resolved to, so reuse is behavior-preserving and avoids a redundant attribute.

keyDecisions.decision: Left HomePage.ts's .nth(1)/.nth(randomIndex) Playwright locator-chaining calls and ProductDetailsPage.ts's page.locator('h2') untouched.
keyDecisions.reasoning: Per analysis.md/architecture-notes.md, these are not has-text/:text/CSS-nth-/nested-selector-string violations under the AC's literal wording — .nth() is a Playwright API method on an already-flat locator, and 'h2' is a bare tag selector with no nesting. Fixing either would be scope creep beyond this spec.
